title: Naala Hai Jibrael Kaa
body:
Naala hai jibraeel ka khaliq duhayi hai
Sajde may tere sher ne talwar khayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Sar pit-te hai ahle jama-at khade hue
Ek shor hai imam ne talwar khayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Allah se yeh kehti thi jannat may Fatima
Bachche mere yateeem hue hay hay duhayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Boli hasan husain se Zainab jigar figaar
Sunti hu mere baba ne talwar khayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aata nahi hai betiyon ko maut ka yakeen
Zainab pukarti hai ke kya neend aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Abbas ka tadapna na Zainab se puchiye
Kehta hai bachpana yahi pehli judayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ekkiswi ko uth gaya duniya na badshah
Mayyat hasan Hussain ne rokar uthayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Afsos ibne muljime maloon ki teg ne
Sibtain ko malal ki surat dikhayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Nana ka hijr ma ka firaaq apne ghar se door
Is dil se pucho jisne yeh mayyat uthayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Ekkiswi ki raat ka pichla woh aakhri
Ek shor hai ke shamma seher jhilmilayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Ai momino tumhara jo pehla imaam tha
Zaalim ne usko sajde me zarbat lagai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Masjid se jarahe hai tahe qabr shere haqq
Ka'ba tabah ho gaya haq ki duhai hai...
